svg.title: Aerathiel — Litany of Dust. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Dust classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Scouring Veil forks into Particle Collapse then Total Disintegration, or Particulate Ward then Atomic Reprisal. Entropic Grasp forks into Hollowing Wind then Terminal Decay, or Withering Gale then Requiem of Dust. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Dust jutsu.

Scouring Veil answers \"How do I turn my Atomic Shield into the weapon: strike harder, or strike back?\": Particle Collapse and Total Disintegration lift the Shield's two compounding damage buffs 35 \u2192 43% (sustained amplification, \u2248 \u00d71.122 on each Dust strike in the window), while Atomic Reprisal lifts the Shield's Reflect to 50% (retaliation). Entropic Grasp answers \"How do I make the enemy decay: open them to every blow, or too weak to land their own?\": Terminal Decay lifts both exposure debuffs to 43% (exposure, \u2248 \u00d71.122 from any attacker), Requiem of Dust lifts Windshear Decay's suppression to 45%. Damage is left unamplified: the trait is sustained damage over time, not burst, and Particle Cannon shares the 60 AP, cooldown-7 profile of the two 40 strikes, so no build lifts it past the Nuke tier. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Dust jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005)."},"nodes":[{"id":"06","name":"Scouring Veil","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"reflect","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"A veil of grit that drives each blow home and bites back at theirs.","coverage_note":"All three Atomic Shield rows: both self damage buffs 35 \u2192 37% and Reflect 40 \u2192 42% (one 40 AP self cast, 2 rounds).","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Dust","scope":"all Dust jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Atomic Shield"],"effect_rows":3}},{"id":"02","name":"Particle Collapse","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["06"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"The shield's gathered dust collapses into every strike.","coverage_note":"Commit: Atomic Shield's two damage buffs 37 \u2192 39% with Scouring Veil; both apply to each Dust strike in the window and compound (\u00d71.39 \u00d7 1.39 \u2248 \u00d71.93 against \u00d71.82 unmodified).","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Dust","scope":"all Dust jutsu","minimum_path_bp":2,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Atomic Shield"],"effect_rows":2}},{"id":"03","name":"Total Disintegration","category":"Advanced Art","cost":1,"parents":["02"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":4,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"Nothing remains to bury.","coverage_note":"Sustained amplification: Atomic Shield's two damage buffs 35 \u2192 43% on the full route; each Dust strike in the two rounds after the cast takes \u00d71.43 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 \u00d72.04 instead of \u00d71.82 (\u2248 \u00d71.122). Draft 5 placed both damage multipliers and flat Damage under one Foundation, so either offensive capstone plus its sibling Hidden Art stacked them on the same strike (Terminal Decay plus Particle Collapse: +10% exposure, +5% amplification and +2 Damage). Here amplification and exposure sit under different Foundations, so neither offensive commit is a fourth purchase for the other offensive capstone.","Damage (final cleanup, R1\u2032): left unamplified. The trait is 'Sustained Damage over time', not Burst, and Particle Cannon is not a signature finisher: it shares 60 AP and cooldown 7 with Death's March and Decaying Touch. Earlier drafts lifted Particle Cannon past the Nuke tier (Draft 5's +5 route, the roster pass's +2 payoff). Total Disintegration now holds the self amplification slot, so every strike keeps its tier (Particle Cannon 50 Nuke, the others 40 Normal). Self amplification does not twin Terminal Decay (enemy exposure from two casts, every attacker), Atomic Reprisal (Reflect) or Requiem of Dust (suppression).","Magnitudes follow R3. Atomic Shield's two Increase Damage Given rows come from one 40 AP cast and compound on each Dust strike, so the amplification route stops at +8% in 2/2/4 steps (\u00d71.43\u00b2 / \u00d71.35\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.122, inside the window only). The two exposure rows sit on separate casts (100 AP together) and compound only while both are up, so Exposure also stops at +8% in 2/2/4 steps (\u2248 \u00d71.122 with both, \u2248 \u00d71.06 with one), against the Shakunetsu Sakura \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes \u00d71.115 exposure anchors; its reach includes every attacker. Reflect and Decrease Damage Given each have one row and take the +10% route (suppression \u00d70.55 / \u00d70.65 \u2248 \u00d70.846). Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Reflect +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%; no Damage.","Filters (\u00a73, register G15): Atomic Shield row 0 (Highest stat, no element) matches the caster's highest-offence-stat and element-less hits; row 2 matches Dust/Earth/Wind and element-less hits, so each Dust strike takes both buffs. Windshear Decay rows 0\u20131 match any stat-based or element-less hit; Death's March row 1 only Dust/Earth/Wind or element-less hits. The passive Increase Damage Given multiplies last.","Delivery and timing (\u00a73b): every cast has cooldown 7. Atomic Shield and Windshear Decay cost 40 AP; Death's March, Decaying Touch and Particle Cannon 60 AP. Each buff or debuff row is live in the two rounds after its cast round, never in it, so Death's March's exposure never boosts its own hit. No rotation was simulated.","Fourth purchase: Total Disintegration takes Entropic Grasp (both exposure debuffs 37%: \u2248 \u00d71.122 \u00d7 1.030 \u2248 \u00d71.156 on a Dust strike into a doubly exposed target inside the Shield window) or Particulate Ward (Reflect 45%). Atomic Reprisal takes Particle Collapse (Shield damage buffs 39%), so Atomic Reprisal + Particle Collapse and Total Disintegration + Particulate Ward share three nodes and trade +5% Reflect against +4% amplification. Terminal Decay takes Scouring Veil (\u2248 \u00d71.122 \u00d7 1.030 \u2248 \u00d71.156 inside the Shield window) or Withering Gale (suppression 40%). Requiem of Dust takes Hollowing Wind (exposure 39%) or Scouring Veil. The no-capstone hybrid Entropic Grasp + Hollowing Wind + Scouring Veil + Particle Collapse (amplify and exposure 39%, \u2248 \u00d71.124 with every window live) gives up both 43% values. Top offensive package \u2248 \u00d71.156, under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234."],"risks":["Classification: Dust is shared with Kyuko-sei and Nejireru Funjin (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). Windshear Decay carries no Dust row, so all of Suppression and half of Exposure need an authored Dust jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1); Atomic Shield rows 0\u20131 (one damage buff and Reflect) need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, so without it the amplification route reaches only row 2 (+8% on one row, \u2248 \u00d71.06). Off-kit Dust coverage is unverified.","Ally hazard (validator WARN accepted): Windshear Decay and Death's March are OTHER_USER circle spawns with friendly fire none/ALL, so exposure up to 43% and suppression up to 45% also land on allies in the radius-1 circle; the caster is never a target.","Exposure is team-wide: an enhanced exposure row raises every matching hit the target takes, allies' and weapons' included, so Terminal Decay's value grows with party size.","Reflect value is downstream: it depends on hits taken in the two-round window, includes pierce hits (which bypass the row's stat filter) and is capped at 60% of each pre-shield hit; 50% stays under the cap. Not simulated.","Unsupported rows (Windshear Decay redirection, Decaying Touch recoil, Particle Cannon wound) are unchanged; the trait 'sustained damage over time' has no supported damage-over-time row.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Dust jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Requiem of Dust path + Hollowing Wind
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE AERATHIEL KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Shield · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
